name: snake-pane
description: Snake in the side pane while Claude works: opens when you send a prompt, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score. /jatek be|ki. Hungarian or English.

language.title: Language / Nyelv
language.description: "auto" (default): Hungarian when the system locale (LANG) is Hungarian, English otherwise. "hu": magyar. "en": English.

autoOpen.title: Open with each prompt
autoOpen.description: Open the game pane when you send a prompt (unless you closed it in this session). /jatek always opens it.
